title: urn:qauth:event:client.first_party_changed:v1-rc.0
description: The client.first_party_changed event, v1-rc.0. An operator set, changed or removed a client's first-party profile (ADR-017 Decision 2), its policy or its written reason. Removing the profile revoked every refresh token family of the client in the same transaction.

id.description: The event id, a UUIDv7. One event keeps one id on every route and every retry, so a receiver drops duplicates by it. It is the `webhook-id` of a webhook and the source of an SSF `jti`.

type.description: The event type, `urn:qauth:event:<name>:v<N>`, or `:v<N>-rc.<M>` for a release candidate. The registry lists every type.

time.description: When the event happened, as an RFC 3339 time in UTC. Not when it was delivered.

realm.description: The id of the realm the event happened in.

category.description: `user`: an end user's own activity. `admin`: an administrator's change. Fixed by the type.

type.description: `user`: a person, signed in. `client`: an OAuth client acting for itself or, with `delegationChain`, as an agent for the subject. `system`: QAuth itself, such as a scheduled job. `operator_cli`: an operator on the server host, through a QAuth command-line tool.

id.description: The actor's identifier: a user id, a client's `client_id`, or the operating-system user for `operator_cli`. Absent for `system`.

delegationChain.description: The RFC 8693 `act` chain of a delegated request, as `client_id` values: the acting agent first, then each earlier actor. Absent when nothing was delegated.

actor.description: Who or what caused the event.

type.description: What kind of thing the subject is.

id.description: The subject's identifier: a user id, a client's `client_id`, an API key id or a Shared Signals Framework `stream_id`. It stays valid after the subject is deleted.

client.description: The OAuth client the request came through.

traceId.description: The id under which QAuth logged the request: the `trace_id` of a problem document from the same request.

ip.description: The end user's IP address, as QAuth derived it from the request. An IPv4-mapped IPv6 address is written in its IPv4 form.

request.description: The HTTP request that caused the event.

from.description: `web_redirect` or `native_backend`: the profile before the change, or `null` when the client was not first party. The set may grow in a minor release.

to.description: The profile after the change, or `null` when it was removed. The set may grow in a minor release.

flows.description: A `native_backend` client's flows after the change: `login`, `register`, `reset`. Absent for any other profile.

pkceRequired.description: Whether a `native_backend` client's policy requires PKCE at the authorization challenge endpoint after the change. `false` is a deviation the operator chose for this client. Absent for any other profile.

writtenReason.description: The reason the operator wrote for the profile, as stored with the client. Absent when the profile was removed.

revokedTokenCount.description: How many refresh tokens the removal revoked: every token of every family of the client that was not already revoked, expired ones included. `0` when the profile was set or changed.

data.description: The type's own payload. Its schema is the type's.
